2607.01776.title: AI Virtue: What is "Good" Knowledge in the Age of Artificial Intelligence?
2607.01776.paper_summary: In the age of AI, what will be good knowledge? This article, which is accepted and forthcoming in a special issue of Modern Fiction Studies on "Cultural AI" in 2027, applies digital humanities methods to map epistemic virtues (like "true," "accurate," "creative") used in a corpus of 553 journal articles on AI published in 2024. "Creativity" comes in for special attention as an example. Exploring this discourse of value, the article considers how a framework might be developed for evaluating the knowledge-worth of AI -- one less locked into values formed around pre-AI "knowledge work" agents or structures, and more open to the future values of "generativity." The essay is supported by an online digital kit for exploring data models of the corpus of articles on AI it studies.
2607.01776.paper_summary_zh: 在人工智慧的時代，什麼才是良好的知識？這篇文章已被接受並將於2027年在《現代小說研究》特刊“文化人工智慧”中發表，運用數位人文方法來描繪在2024年發表的553篇有關人工智慧的期刊文章中使用的認識論美德（如“真實”、“準確”、“創造性”）。 “創造性”作為一個例子受到特別關注。探索這種價值的話語，文章考慮如何建立一個框架來評估人工智慧的知識價值——這個框架不再僅僅鎖定於圍繞前人工智慧“知識工作”代理或結構形成的價值，而是更開放於“生成性”的未來價值。這篇論文還配有一個在線數位工具包，以探索其研究的人工智慧文章語料庫的數據模型。
2607.01776.author: Alan Liu et.al.
